findings: Original base24 candidate rows are unchanged; only fitting objective and binary user-weight policy differ.
Fit target is full-universe top5_count80; complete filtered groups preserve original row contiguity for rank_xendcg.
Binary uses identical retained fitting groups; weights N/(G*rowsingroup) have mean1 and equal total pergroup. No evaluation labels enter these weights.
Positive binary probability is selected using classes_ index1, never hard predictedclasses.
Reciprocal ranks include all finite scores including negatives; score scales are removed by within-user numeric-ID-tied ranking.
Equal pairfusions and primary equal all3 RRF60 are prespecified; no blend search.
Existing Metric applies unchanged cold popularity fallback after either standalone or fused ranking.
Evaluation reports all80 and top5count80 full-universe MAP denominators on both reusedwindows. No exact-MAP-loss claim.
caveats: Two objective variants and fixed fusions still add exploratory comparisons on reused windows.
rank_xendcg and binary weighted loss are alternative surrogates, not proof of the hidden preference formula or global optimum.
